source_refs.note: Prior baseline evidence for store1 = SDK v1 on this same campaign 2595, used to resolve the product URL/handle and as the 'evidence_a' side of CONFLICT-PORTAL-001
Prior baseline evidence for store2 = SDK v2 on campaign 2595

observations: Both storefronts were reached directly at the previously-known campaign 2595 URL (handle 'qa-explore-campaign-pb-01') without needing to guess a new route -- password gate passed with TIB_STORE_PASSWORD, product title 'QA Explore Campaign PB 01' and product ids (store1: 8138398629987, store2: 15280333291824) matched the prior baseline exactly, and the public bootstrap endpoint GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{product_id}.json fired on both, confirming this is the same campaign/object as the 2026-09-12 v1/v2 baseline -- not a different campaign.

MAJOR FINDING: on store1 (linh-explorer.myshopify.com), the SDK script tags are now https://staging-sdk.teeinblue.com/shopify/app-v2.js and .../async.js?...&v=2 (NOT app-v1.js/&v=1 as recorded in the 2026-09-12 baseline), and the widget root container class is 'tee-campaign tee-campaign-v2 tee-customization-wrapper' (was 'tee-campaign tee-campaign-v1 tee-customization-wrapper' in the baseline). This is a direct, literal SDK-version marker embedded by the bundle itself, not an inference.

store2 (linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com) shows the identical markers: app-v2.js, async.js?v=2, container class 'tee-campaign tee-campaign-v2 tee-customization-wrapper' -- consistent with its 2026-09-12 baseline (already v2), so no change there.

Beyond the version markers, the entire observable personalization DOM for campaign 2595 is now byte-identical between store1 and store2: same element ids (e.g. #4081-template-template-277843/-578330/-156669), same field labels, same clipart element counts (16), same price ($55.99), same theme-scoped CSS custom properties (--tee-*). This was cross-checked independently in two separate script runs (initial discovery pass and a deep-dive pass) with consistent results both times.

Personalization mechanism observed for this campaign/template: a top-level radio group of 3 template thumbnails (role=radiogroup is NOT actually used at the top level -- it is 3 separate <label for=...> clipart-thumbnail controls sharing name='4081', i.e. a flat radio set, not the 'grouped_clipart 2-step radio-then-child-click' pattern nor a '~9/10 item nested radiogroup' described in the pre-2026-09-12 KB). Selecting template option 2 dynamically reveals 7 additional REQUIRED fields (Skin Tone select, Hairstyle select, Woman Name text, Cat Breed #1 select, Cat Name #1 text, Cat Breed #2 select, Cat Name #2 text) -- a 2-level dependency (template selection -> reveals child field set), confirmed identically on both stores. This is evidence of a real 2-level dependency mechanism still present on BOTH stores today, but its shape (dropdowns/text fields, not nested clipart images) differs from both prior v1 and v2 descriptions in the KB -- flagged as an unknown/nuance, not force-fit into either label.

Artwork/mockup preview mechanism (clicked the in-widget 'Preview' button with template 1 default, no missing required fields): opens a popup with class 'vm--modal' > 'tee-dialog-inner' > 'tee-gallery-content' > 'tee-mockup-image', rendering an -based mockup with a 'tee-printarea' overlay div. Zero elements with [data-layer-id] were found in the popup on either store -- i.e. neither store showed the 'live SVG map by layer-id' mechanism the KB attributes to v2 for this template. The popup DOM (svgCount, imgCount, class names, nested structure) was BYTE-IDENTICAL between store1 and store2. This mechanism doesn't cleanly match either the old v1 'static lightbox mockup' or old v2 'live SVG' description as previously worded -- but the key fact for CONFLICT-PORTAL-001 is that it is now IDENTICAL on both stores, which is itself strong corroborating evidence of a shared runtime version, consistent with the script-tag/container-class finding.

Add-to-cart was attempted on both stores with template option 2 selected (the 7 dependent fields left empty, since filling them was outside this run's minimum-scope goal). Result was symmetric on both stores: an inline validation message 'Error: Some fields are required or invalid data' appeared, GET /cart.json showed item_count: 0 on both immediately after, and the captured network log shows ZERO requests to any '.../shopify/customization' or cart/add endpoint on either store -- the block happened client-side before any network call, on both stores identically. This does not resolve CONFLICT-001 (store1 ATC completion, still open) since a fully valid personalization was not attempted this run, but it is a new symmetric data point: no store1/store2 asymmetry was observed in this particular (invalid-state) ATC attempt, unlike the older CONFLICT-001 evidence which compared a store1 hard-fail against a store2 full success.

Theme identity reconfirmed unchanged from the 2026-09-12 baseline: store1 = Dawn 16.0.0 (theme id 143116042339, role main), store2 = 'test-data' / Generated Data Theme 1.0.0 (theme id 188105261360, role main). Theme did not change; only the teeinblue SDK bundle/version marker changed for store1.

Cart state verified empty (item_count: 0, items: []) on both stores at the end of the session -- no cleanup action was required beyond the automatic /cart/clear.js safety call built into the script (which was a no-op here since nothing was ever added).
assumptions: Assumed the product handle 'qa-explore-campaign-pb-01' used in the 2026-09-12 baseline still points to campaign 2595 on both stores -- this was VERIFIED, not left as a bare assumption: product title, product ids, and the campaign bootstrap API call (GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{id}.json) all matched the prior evidence on both stores, so this is now an observed fact rather than an assumption.
unknowns: Whether template option 3 (not tested this run, only option 2 was) also reveals the same or a different additional-required-field set, on either store.

Full contract/shape of the 2-level dependency mechanism (template -> 7 dependent fields) relative to the KB's prior 'nested radiogroup ~10 clipart' (v1) and 'grouped_clipart 2-step grid ~9 clipart' (v2) descriptions -- this run's campaign/template combination shows neither pattern verbatim (it is select/text dependent fields, not nested clipart image grids). Could mean the KB's v1/v2 mechanism descriptions were specific to a DIFFERENT template within campaign 2595, or to a different campaign entirely (e.g. 2605), and this run's template 1-vs-2 comparison is simply a different facet of the same campaign not previously exercised. NOT resolved this run -- flagged for a follow-up pass that walks all 3 templates on both stores.

Full add-to-cart completion (valid personalization through to a confirmed cart line item) was not achieved this run on either store -- CONFLICT-001 (store1 ATC completion) remains open and is NOT addressed by this run's data point.
Buyer logged-in state, non-US market/locale/currency, and mobile/tablet viewports were not tested this run (guest, US, desktop only, matching the prior baseline's own limitations).

conflicts.description: SDK version per store, now with a THIRD data point layered on top of the original two. Evidence_a (oldest, PRE-2026-09-12 storefront runtime baseline carried in knowledge/products/teeinblue/objects/sdk/feature-summary.md FEAT-07): store1 = SDK v1 (nested radiogroup ~10 clipart, static lightbox mockup), store2 = SDK v2, based on direct storefront observation of campaign 2595 as of runs up to CTX-20260912-05. Evidence_b (this workflow, portal-side, 2026-09-21): GET /api/instances?trashed returns sdk_version:2 for BOTH instance 609 (store1) and instance 613 (store2) -- portal-explorer flagged this as contradicting evidence_a and handed off to storefront-explorer for a fresh runtime check (this artifact). Evidence_c (this artifact, storefront-side runtime re-check, 2026-09-21, SAME campaign 2595/handle as evidence_a): store1 now serves staging-sdk.teeinblue.com/shopify/app-v2.js and a 'tee-campaign-v2' container class -- the literal opposite of what evidence_a recorded for this exact campaign/store combination. store2 is unchanged (still v2, matching both evidence_a and evidence_b).

evidence_a.note: FEAT-07 capabilities #2,#3,#6 and knowledge/products/teeinblue/objects/sdk/kb.json -- store1=SDK v1 as of runs up to CTX-20260912-05, sourced from runs/context/2026-09-12/CTX-20260912-03/raw/storefront/storefront-evidence-store1-v1.json (script tag app-v1.js, container class tee-campaign-v1, header x-sdk-version: 1.0.3)

evidence_b.note: GET /api/instances?trashed, seq 4 -- sdk_version:2 for instance 609 (store1). Same field/value also captured independently at raw/network/ACT-01-04-001.json seq 3 for instance 613 (store2), act_id ACT-01-04-001.

evidence_c.note: This run's storefront-side script-tag + container-class + DOM structure capture on the SAME campaign 2595 URL used for evidence_a, dated 2026-09-21. See also raw/storefront/dom/store1-body.html, raw/storefront/screenshots/store1-product-page.png, raw/storefront/network/store1-deep-network-log.json (all show app-v2.js / tee-campaign-v2 for store1).

conflicts.resolution: NOT unilaterally resolved by storefront-explorer, per contract sec.8 (only orchestrator/reviewer decide conflict resolution). RECOMMENDATION FOR REVIEWER: evidence_b and evidence_c independently converge (portal API field AND fresh storefront runtime both say v2 for store1 today), while evidence_a is the odd one out and is also the OLDEST of the three, dated before 2026-09-12. The most defensible reading is that store1 was migrated/upgraded from SDK v1 to SDK v2 for campaign 2595 at some point between the CTX-20260912-05 baseline and this run (2026-09-21), and the portal API's sdk_version field is CURRENTLY accurate for both stores. This is a recommendation, not a decision -- the KB (feature-summary.md / kb.json for object 'sdk', and any FEAT-07 checklist items keyed to 'store1 = v1') should be treated as STALE for store1 pending explicit reviewer sign-off and a version-history note (not a silent overwrite), since evidence_a was itself a confirmed direct observation at the time it was recorded and is not being called 'wrong', only 'no longer current'.
